description: Agent Help Network plugins for Claude Code. Agent Help Network is an independent project.

plugins.name: ahn
plugins.description: Look up a failed web step's hostname on Agent Help Network: declared agent policy, official developer path, provider status, and one recommended action. The hook is read-only and sends the hostname only; the bundled MCP server's report_observation write tool is for use only with the user's explicit approval, never automatically.
